questions.questionText: It ensures that system information or processes are protected from intentional accidental modification.
One way to ensure integrity is to use a ____________________ or ___________.
It means that authorized users are able to access systems and data when and where needed and those that do not meet established conditions, are not.
This can be achieved by maintaining equipment, performing hardware repairs, keeping operating systems and software up to date, and creating backups.
Refers to data that use being used to perform an operation such as updating a database record (data in process).
Refers to data stored in memory or on a permanent storage device such as a hard drive, solid-state drive or USB drive (data at rest).
Refers to data travelling between information systems (data in transit).
DIKW pyramid meaning.
The measures put in place by an organization to ensure that users are knowledgeable about security threats and the actions they can take to protect information systems.
Refers to the software and hardware based solutions designed to protect information systems such as firewalls, which continuoisly monitor your network in search of possible malicious incidents.
Refers to the administrative controls that provide a foundation for how an organization implements information assurance, such as incident response plans and best practice guidelines.

In 2017, an Internet of Things botnet, Persirai targeted over 1,000 different models of Internet Protocols (IP) cameras, accessing open ports to inject a command that forced the cameras to connect to a site which installed malware on them. Once the malware was downloaded and executed, it deleted itself and was therefore able to run in memory to avoid detection.

In September 2017, a consumer credit reporting agency in the US, publicly announced a data breach event. Attackers had been able to exploit a vulnerability in its web application software to gain access to the sensitive personal data of millions of customers.
A security breach can have a negative long-term impact on an organization's reputation that has taken years to build.

A hacker or hacking group may vandalize an organization's website by posting untrue information. They might even just make a few minors edits to your organization's phone number or address, which can be tricker to detect.
A data breach often involves an incident where sensitive personal data has been stolen. Cybercriminals can make this information public or exploit it to steal an individual's money or identity.
The financial impact of a security breach can be devastating. For example, hackers can take down an organization's website, preventing it from doing business online.

A security breach could also have a devastating impact on the comptitiveness of an organization, particularly if hackers are able to get their hands on confidential documents, trade and secrets and intellectual property.
The term 'script kiddies' emerged in the 1990s and refers to amateur or inexperienced hackers who use existing tools or instructions found on the Internet to launch attacks.
Group of attackers break into computer systems or networks to gain access.
They make political statements to create awareness about issues that are important to them.
They gather intelligence or commit sabotage on behalf of their government.
Types of threats.

As its name suggests, is the use of technology to penetrate and attack another nation's computer systems and networks in an effort to cause damage or disrupt services, such as shutting down a power grid.
Types of malware.
questions.answer: Spyware, Adware, Backdoor, Ransomware, Scareware, Rootkit, Virus, Trojan Horse, Worms

questions.questionText: Designed to track and spy on you, spyware monitors your online activity and can log every key you press on your keyboard, as well as capture almost any of your data, including sensitive personal information such as your online banking details.

Is often installed with some versions of software and is designed to automatically deliver advertisements to a user, most often on a web browser. You know it when you see it! It's hard to ignore when you're faced with constant pop-up ads on your screen.

Used to gain unauthorized access by bypassing the normal authentication procedures to access a system. As a result, hackers can gain remote access to resources within an application and issue remote system commands.
They are designed to hold a computer system or the data it contains captive until payment is made. Ransomware usually works by encrypting your data so that you can't access it.

It uses 'scare' tactics to trick you into taking a specific action. Scareware mainly consists of operating system style windows that pop-up to warn you that your system is at risk and needs to run a specific program for it to return to normal operation.

It is designed to modify the operating system to create a backdoor, which attackers can then use to access your computer remotely. Most rootkits take advantage of software vulnerabilities to gain access to resources that normally shouldn't be accessible (privilege escalation) and modify system files.

When executed, it replicates and attaches itself to other executable files, such as a document, by inserting its own code. Most viruses require end-user interaction to initiate activation and can be written to act on a specific date or time.

It carries out malicious operations by masking its true intent. It might appear legitimate but is, in fact, very dangerous. It exploit your user privileges and are most often found in image files, audio files or games.
It replicates itself in order to spread from one computer to another. Unlike a virus, which requires a host program to run, worms can run by themselves.

Symptoms of Malware:
- An increase in ___ usage, which slows down your device.
- Your computer freezing or ___________ often.
- A decrease in your _____________________ speed.
- Unexplainable problems with your _________________________.
questions.answer: CPU, Crashing, Web Browsing, Network Connections
